scenarios.label: Micro-task only
scenarios.description: No standardized service price applies. Single small task or minor adjustment.

scenarios.label: One standardized task
scenarios.description: A single identifiable standardized FIXEO service is booked.
scenarios.rule: Use the standardized service price. Do NOT add BRIC-001 minimum-visit charge.

scenarios.label: Open-ended or variable scope
scenarios.description: Task list uncertain, duration unclear, or medium/large furniture.

scenarios.label: Multiple mixed tasks, approximately 3–4 hours
scenarios.description: Multiple heterogeneous handyman tasks in one visit.

scenarios.label: Multiple homogeneous items
scenarios.description: Batch of same task type (e.g. multiple shelves).
scenarios.note: No universal additional-item percentage approved. Requires FIXEO transaction data or dedicated batch-calibration phase. Interim: use HALF_DAY (BRIC-003) or HOURLY (BRIC-002) as appropriate.

scope_contract.tasks_included: One micro-task or a small group of micro-tasks fitting inside included duration
scope_contract.standard_consumables: INCLUDED — normal screws and wall plugs for compatible standard fixing
scope_contract.anti_double_charge_rule: IF a standardized FIXEO task (BRIC-010, BRIC-020, BRIC-030) is booked in the same visit, BRIC-001 is NOT additionally charged. Standardized task price embeds travel.
scope_contract.after_30_min: Transition to BRIC-002 hourly rate. Client notified and approves before time extension.

complexity_escape.trigger: Any on-site condition that materially exceeds the defined scope
protocol: DECLARE: Cette intervention est HORS PÉRIMÈTRE PRIX FIXEO

metier_boundaries.ELECTRICITE: Any wiring, circuit, socket modification → route to ELECTRICITE
metier_boundaries.PLOMBERIE: Any pipe, drain, water-system modification → route to PLOMBERIE
metier_boundaries.SERRURERIE: Lock cylinder, security door → route to SERRURERIE
metier_boundaries.MACONNERIE: Structural wall or load-bearing uncertainty → STOP, route to MAÇONNERIE

scope_contract.billing_after_minimum: Actual time rounded to nearest 30 minutes
scope_contract.duration_estimate: Artisan provides estimated duration range before work begins. No silent time extension.
use_cases: Open-ended task list where duration is uncertain
Heterogeneous tasks not fitting a single standardized service
Medium or large furniture assembly where fixed scope is not reliable
Work expected to materially exceed the BRIC-001 minimum-visit contract

scope_contract.specialist_tasks: EXCLUDED — specialist métier tasks route to specialist (ELECTRICITE, PLOMBERIE, etc.)
scope_contract.primary_use: Multiple heterogeneous tasks where individual task pricing would create unreasonable repeated travel-inclusive charges

scope_contract.standard_scope: One small flat-pack furniture item. Typically one package. No complex wardrobe system. No structural or custom carpentry. Expected assembly duration approximately 45 minutes or less.
scope_contract.anti_double_charge_rule: BRIC-001 minimum visit is NOT additionally charged. Task price embeds travel.
escape_conditions: Actual complexity materially exceeds this contract → escape to BRIC-002 HOURLY or DEVIS
Multiple packages for single item → re-assess as medium or large furniture
Missing parts or damaged flat-pack → STOP → notify client → document

scope_contract.standard_scope: One shelf. Standard eligible substrate. Normal accessible working height. Drilling, levelling, fixing.
scope_contract.consumables: Standard compatible wall anchors and screws INCLUDED for normal masonry fixing
scope_contract.anti_double_charge_rule: BRIC-001 minimum visit is NOT additionally charged. Task price embeds travel.
standard_eligible_substrates: Ordinary compatible concrete where normal drilling is safe

conditional_substrates.action: HORS PÉRIMÈTRE workflow: STOP → IDENTIFY → EXPLAIN → DECLARE → STATE revised scope → OBTAIN approval → CONTINUE

substrates: Tadelakt / pisé where reliable fixing is uncertain
escape_substrates.action: QUOTE_REQUIRED — reliable standard fixing not possible

specialist_required.action: STOP — route to MAÇONNERIE or structural specialist

specialty_hardware.policy: PART_SEPARATE_WITH_DISCLOSURE — must be disclosed when required. No silent markup.

services.label: Fixation TV murale standard
services.strongest_evidence: m3allempro.com Casablanca: 300 MAD, 89 reviews, 412 missions, bracket excluded

standard_eligibility.bracket_type: Fixed or simple tilt — NOT full-motion complex bracket when substantially more work is required
standard_eligibility.wall: Compatible standard substrate at normal safe working height

explicit_exclusions: Electrical socket relocation → routes to ELECTRICITE
Electrical wiring modification → routes to ELECTRICITE
Full-motion or complex bracket when substantially more work required
Oversized or very heavy TV requiring second worker
Specialist chemical anchoring unless separately disclosed

escape_conditions.action: HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → specialty anchors → disclose + approve
HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → stud confirmation required → conditional
HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → diamond bit, crack risk disclosure + approve

escape_conditions.condition: Full-motion articulating bracket adding substantial complexity

escape_conditions.action: HORS PÉRIMÈTRE → second worker required → quote

escape_conditions.condition: Any cable concealment requiring socket or wiring work
escape_conditions.action: STOP → route to ELECTRICITE — NOT bricolage scope

escape_conditions.condition: Marble, fragile stone, or uncertain structural wall

scope_contract.metier_boundary_critical: ANY electrical modification routes to ELECTRICITE. This boundary is absolute.

services.label: Montage armoire / grand meuble
services.interim_architecture: HOURLY (BRIC-002) or QUOTE_REQUIRED depending on scope

services.label: Pose cadre / tableau
services.note: Small frame or hook tasks may fall under BRIC-001 minimum visit. No standalone standardized price to be created.
